title: Space Force reopens $13 billion satellite services program to new vendors
big: 9 new stories. The new stories are led by drones; the top five are mostly about counter-drone and drones.

stories.h: Space Force reopens $13 billion satellite services program to new vendors
stories.what: SpaceX accounts for about 96% of nearly $1 billion in recorded obligations under the program.

stories.h: Rafael shows its laser in action at U.S.-Israel drone trials
stories.what: Israel's Rafael Advanced Defense Systems has released new footage of its laser weapon from Black Sands, the first joint U.S.-Israeli counter-drone trials held on Israeli soil. Don't believe us?

stories.h: Leonardo rolls out first M-346 jet for Italy’s Air Force stunt flying unit
stories.what: ROME — Italian defense giant Leonardo has rolled out the first of 15 M-346 jets due to take over stunt flying duties with the Italian Air Force's aerobatic team.

stories.h: Canadian armored vehicles proven in Ukraine find new buyers
stories.what: Canadian armored vehicle maker Roshel has picked up two new orders for its Senator in Latin America in a single week: six armored personnel carriers for Guatemala's military and 24 vehicles for police in Rio de Janeiro.

stories.h: France kicks off defense-industry pact to build up counter-drone efforts

watch.h: Stopgap funding expires: FY27 appropriations or another CR
watch.why: December 11. Decides whether DAWG's $54.6B and Golden Dome's growth become real money.

idea.h: Contract intelligence and capture agent for small vendors
idea.why: An LLM agent that watches SAM.gov, DIU, OTA consortia, budget documents and portfolio acquisition executives, matches openings to a product, and drafts responses. Thousands of new vendors are navigating DAWG and the new acquisition rules; turning valuations into orders is the stated test.
